## Tracking

Tracking: #<issue>

## Problem

What tracked problem does this PR solve? Keep this narrower than the implementation description.

## Change

What changed, and which behavior/invariant is affected?

## Docs impact

Docs-Impact: updated

<!-- If no durable docs are affected, replace the line above with:
Docs-Impact: none - <specific reason>
-->

## Evidence

List the exact checks/tests/observations used. For critical behavior, state whether the test traverses the real composition path.

## Architecture impact

- Does this change an authoritative state writer, lifecycle transition, trust boundary, or component dependency? If yes, where is that durable design change documented?
- What simpler/mature alternative was considered if this introduces a new mechanism?

## Checklist

- [ ] The tracking issue contains acceptance criteria.
- [ ] Scope is limited to the tracked problem.
- [ ] Documentation is updated or the no-docs reason is explicit.
- [ ] Relevant tests/checks pass.
- [ ] No new architecture/product boundary was added merely because the problem is difficult.
